scopePrinciple: Finite mandatory criteria for the committed general B2B SaaS offering; no external certificate claimed.

scoring.rule: An A criterion counts as PASS only with fresh reproducible required evidence bound to applicable exact SHA/runtime and authorized approval; unknown counts 0. All applicable A must PASS; any material risk invalidates final approval.

B: SAML/SCIM/SSO or bespoke IdP if specifically contracted
Customer-mandated SOC 2/ISO 27001 or external authenticated pentest
Custom integration, data-export spec or security assessment
Public sector sector-specific accreditation, if contracted
C: Noncritical cosmetic refinements and expanded UI variants
Kubernetes or multi-cloud for hypothetical future scale
Index tuning without measured material operating impact
D: Conformity assessment for a customer-operated high-risk AI system: not performed by SaaS supplier unless itself legally assigned such role
Payment institution authorization: app uses Stripe and does not itself provide regulated payment services
Medical-device software certification for an offering that is not a medical device

acceptanceRules: Material critical/high issues cannot be excluded from A without documented risk and applicability review.
A PASS requires reproducible provider/runtime/test evidence, exact-SHA binding where applicable and a reviewer/approver.
No blanket-equivalence: source tests are not runtime tests; READY does not prove customer flow; Stripe live price does not prove TEST lifecycle.
B becomes blocking only when an affected customer commitment is made. C never blocks unless reclassified for verified material risk. D requires rationale.
Freeze changes require an identified new applicable material risk, documented rationale and owner approval.
This scope does not auto-override the existing config/enterprise-100-closure.json or weaken active release/security policies.

mandatory.criterion: Session authentication, recovery and logout reject expired/revoked sessions in authenticated browser/API tests
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Authenticated run logs, replayable negative session fixtures

mandatory.criterion: Every mandatory read and mutation is authorized server-side by active membership and role, including deny tests
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Role/permission matrix plus negative API integration evidence

mandatory.criterion: Tenant A cannot read, mutate, export or download tenant B records via API, RLS and Storage
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Tenant A/B authenticated runtime and SQL/RLS/Storage results

mandatory.criterion: Privileged SQL functions, elevated writers, files and webhooks are restricted to intended principals
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Production grants/policy readback and unauthorized-invocation tests

mandatory.criterion: Secrets never reach client bundles or logs; TLS and at-rest protection are appropriately configured
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Secret scanner, deployed configuration attestation, transport/storage checks

mandatory.criterion: No known unaccepted material high/critical issue in committed flows; privileged actions have durable audit events
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Risk register, vulnerability dispositions, event replay and audit outputs

mandatory.criterion: A legitimate user signs up, authenticates and creates/joins the intended workspace
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Authenticated signup/onboarding E2E and durable DB readback

mandatory.criterion: AI inventory create/view/update and risk assessment persist with correct tenant and ownership
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Authenticated E2E plus persisted record and isolation evidence

mandatory.criterion: Governance workflow records accountable owner, decision, timestamps, review state and supporting evidence
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Multi-role approval/deny E2E and durable audit trail

mandatory.criterion: Evidence uploads/downloads, audit trail, mandatory reporting and document export work with access controls
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Authenticated browser/API tests, generated file inspection and data readback

mandatory.criterion: Administration, retention/deletion/export and privacy request workflows fulfill the published offering
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Role-specific E2E, data deletion/retention and export evidence

mandatory.criterion: Navigation and actual product contracts match what is marketed; incomplete optional flows are not sold as complete
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Release-scoped product route inventory and marketing/contract mismatch review

mandatory.criterion: Publicly committed plans map to existing correctly configured Stripe prices and intended access limits
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Redacted Stripe product/price IDs and offer-to-entitlement mapping
mandatory.acceptedBy: G1 Engineering, owner-authorized acceptance (independent Stripe LIVE + Vercel provider readbacks; governed PR integration pending)
mandatory.acceptanceNotes: BIL-01 provider/source catalog only: 6/6 correct active LIVE products and Prices with exact Production Vercel bindings and main SHA; code-described plan limits and sales-led contract boundaries. Does not credit checkout, signed webhooks, entitlements persistence or authorization (BIL-02/03/04/05).

mandatory.criterion: Signed Stripe TEST webhooks reject invalid signatures and replay/duplicates safely
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Genuine Stripe test event, webhook delivery IDs and idempotency readback

mandatory.criterion: A genuine test Checkout creates and persists the expected organization entitlement in isolated QA
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Exact-SHA Stripe TEST event linked to QA durable DB state and app entitlement

mandatory.criterion: Plan changes, nonpayment and cancellation converge on durable, safe subscription states
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Genuine Stripe TEST lifecycle events plus authenticated UI/backend assertions

mandatory.criterion: Access checks and billing modifications are authorized server-side; customer cannot self-grant a paid tier
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Negative API tests and tenant-isolated entitlement query evidence

mandatory.criterion: An ordered, reconciled and reviewed migration manifest bootstraps isolated QA without version collisions
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Approved replay manifest, migration hashes, SQL replay log and schema parity check

mandatory.criterion: Concurrent membership changes and usage quotas preserve critical invariants or fail atomically
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Native PostgreSQL concurrent-session tests and repeatable invariant queries

mandatory.criterion: High-value decisions, audit-chain and billing state survive transaction failure/retry without untracked divergence
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Rollback/atomicity negative cases, constraint assertions and audit-chain validation

mandatory.criterion: A bounded isolated restoration proves DB and relevant Auth/Storage/application recovery boundaries
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Restore transcript, data integrity diff, Auth/Storage scope and recovery limitation log

mandatory.criterion: Production migrations, RLS/FORCE RLS, RPC grants and data boundaries match the approved release
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Version-scoped provider SQL readback, function ACL and grant tests

mandatory.criterion: Mandatory application/unit/integration and security regression suites complete without failing checks
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Exact-SHA test logs and results for full required suites

mandatory.criterion: Real authenticated browser tests cover core user journeys and tenant A/B access denies
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Exact-SHA Playwright logs, artifacts sanitized of private data

mandatory.criterion: Billing plus error, retries, persistence, cancellations and degraded behavior pass application/runtime E2E
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Exact-SHA runtime/Stripe sandbox QA report

mandatory.criterion: Test source SHA, build, QA environment and deployed tested artifact are traceable; no synthetic substitution
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Signed or otherwise independently verifiable check IDs, exact-SHA provenance

mandatory.criterion: The current production deployment is READY, its exact SHA is known and release acceptance uses that SHA
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Live Vercel deployment ID/commit SHA and domain assignment verification
mandatory.acceptedBy: G1 Engineering, owner-authorized acceptance (provider evidence review, pending governed PR integration)
mandatory.acceptanceNotes: OPS-01 only: production READY deployment, exact Git SHA, verified domain and hostname resolution cross-checked with Vercel and GitHub; evidence frozen at baseline SHA. Does not imply full release gate or product QA.

mandatory.criterion: Protected or equivalently controlled merges/releases require approved review, trustworthy checks and explicit release decision
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Readback of native rule enforcement or documented audited equivalent controls

mandatory.criterion: Public critical routes and an authenticated core workflow pass deployment-specific smoke checks
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Runtime smoke results and health/endpoints with exact deployment identity

mandatory.criterion: Production monitoring, alert routing, incident response and support contact operate and are documented
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Provider alert check, incident drill, runbook and support route

mandatory.criterion: A governed rollback/recovery exercise verifies safe restore of a known-good release without customer-data mutation
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Isolated/staged rehearsal log, rollback target SHA and acceptance record

mandatory.criterion: QA, live, preview and production configuration and credentials stay isolated and fail closed
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Environment provenance matrix, safe negative-cross-environment tests

mandatory.criterion: Operator/contracting entity and software rights are identified and supported by appropriate corporate evidence
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Authoritative supplier/ownership records, reviewed identity statement

mandatory.criterion: Product terms, privacy notice and applicable DPA are accurate, accessible and reviewed for the target service
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Versioned terms/privacy/DPA, legal approver identity, effective dates

mandatory.criterion: Subprocessors, retention/deletion, transfers and GDPR role allocation match operating reality
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Verified vendor list and data flow, retention schedule and legal/privacy sign-off

mandatory.criterion: AI Act and independent-assurance marketing statements are scoped, current and do not imply false certification
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Fact/legal review checklist and approved claim inventory

mandatory.criterion: Customer-ready security questionnaire, disclosure/contact route, support and incident commitments are truthful
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Evidence-indexed procurement packet, tested contact path and approved commitments

mandatory.criterion: All legal obligations applicable to the offered scope have a documented qualified acceptance or bounded unresolved decision
mandatory.evidenceRequired: Applicable-obligation matrix, legal reviewer conclusions and approved exceptions
